sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: You've got to be kidding me. Today of all days?
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, okay. Don't panic. Fast walk, transfer, survive.
sprite_sequence.label: serious_expressionless

sprite_sequence.text: Made it! Barely! I am never trusting that line again.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.text: Year one, class three... end of the hall, right?
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: What kind of map prints north in six-point font?!
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on... please let the teacher be nice.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Please tell me you're also in 1-3 and not judging me too hard.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Then lead the way, hero. I'll owe you my life for at least one lunch break.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.text: Thank you! I swear this is not my usual brand.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.text: Okay. New term status: messy start, but not a total disaster.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile
